activity.notes: Stanisław II August (Stanisław August Poniatowski) was elected on 6 September 1764 and was the final monarch of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. His reign ended with his abdication on 25 November 1795 after the Third Partition. ATLAS records the Commonwealth-level sovereign Activity rather than a Poland-only monarchy.

sources.title: Zamek w epoce króla Stanisława Augusta — Zamek Królewski w Warszawie
sources.citation_text: The Royal Castle in Warsaw identifies Stanisław August Poniatowski as the last Polish monarch, ruling from 1764 until his abdication in 1795.

sources.title: Stanisław August Poniatowski — Archiwum Państwowe w Łodzi
sources.citation_text: The State Archives in Łódź records his election on 6 September 1764, coronation later that year, and abdication on 25 November 1795 after the Third Partition.
